Use case: illustration-story. Production art assets for Farbtupf, a first-grade children's learning app in Zürich. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its Waldatelier watercolour-and-gouache medium, fine warm-sepia details, orange fox with green neckerchief, natural moss greens, terracotta, golden ochre, soft lake blue and warm ivory. Original commissioned children's picture-book illustration; refined, softly painted, observed silhouettes and subtle pigment texture, with strong readable shapes. No UI, frames, badges, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, emojis or plastic 3D.
Asset: a beautiful wide landscape painting, 3:2, WITHOUT any user interface or text. Match the woodland-and-Zürich-lake scene from the reference home screen. A mature leafy tree frames the left and upper left, and a lovable small orange fox with a green neckerchief sits on a mossy rock at the lower left. The fox takes only the left quarter. Across the middle: peaceful Lake Zürich, a tiny sailboat and the distant twin towers of Grossmünster. The right half is open light sky and soft pale water, with minimal details and gentle painterly light, to place real app controls on later. The scenery must extend naturally edge-to-edge. Warm daylight, fine botanical foreground. No fox on the right, no UI, no words or counters. Horizontal landscape artwork with the same warm painterly brushwork as the reference.

The sheet must be square; all 16 cells equal; background truly transparent. Preserve fine watercolour detail and recognisable silhouettes at small sizes.
